scenario: A six-week leadership course promises learners will conduct a structured change-impact analysis. The only graded assessment asks them to recall definitions from a glossary.
source_evidence: Learning objective says apply a change-impact analysis; quiz checks remembering only.
corrected_action: Replace or supplement recall questions with a scored case-based change-impact assessment using transparent criteria.
critical_error: Mismatch between applied objective and recall-only assessment.

scenario: A mandatory self-paced online training video includes spoken instructions and important audio cues but provides no captions.
source_evidence: Captions are unavailable; the audio content is not reproduced in synchronized text.
corrected_action: Add accurate synchronized captions for speech and relevant non-speech audio; review against applicable accessibility criteria and with human testers.

scenario: A model states that a particular learning methodology guarantees a 90% performance improvement for all participants, without evidence or any documented baseline.
source_evidence: No study, baseline, population or measurement design is provided.
corrected_action: Remove unsupported guarantee; make a qualified rationale and propose a measurable evaluation design.
critical_error: Universal outcome claim unsupported by evidence.

scenario: A remote professional course offers guided practice, a realistic business case, a clear rubric, alternative accessible formats, and performance review by a qualified assessor.
source_evidence: Objectives, authentic task and rubric are aligned; documented alternatives are available.
corrected_action: Retain the design, validate accessibility with users and collect post-course performance evidence.
critical_error: No decisive defect within the supplied scenario.

scenario: An onboarding course claims to have improved job performance simply because 100% of the participants clicked 'complete'. It contains no behavioral evidence or assessment.
source_evidence: Completion statistics measure activity, not competence or transfer to work.
corrected_action: Define observable performance criteria, pre/post tasks and a follow-up measure; report completion separately from effectiveness.
critical_error: Activity metric presented as evidence of learning transfer.

scenario: An online drag-and-drop quiz can only be answered using a mouse, with no keyboard-equivalent interaction.
source_evidence: Required task depends on pointer input only.
corrected_action: Implement keyboard-operable interaction and accessible alternatives; test with keyboard and assistive technology.
critical_error: Interaction requires a mouse and excludes keyboard-only users.

scenario: A field workforce frequently works with slow mobile internet. The entire training programme requires uninterrupted high-resolution streaming and offers no transcript, download or low-bandwidth option.
source_evidence: Network constraints are documented; delivery assumes continuous high bandwidth.
corrected_action: Offer mobile-first, low-bandwidth and downloadable resources, captions/transcripts, and asynchronous activities, with privacy review where needed.
critical_error: Digital delivery ignores learner context and limits equitable access.

scenario: A digital learning unit provides text, captioned video, accessible diagrams, optional practice, a choice of equivalent assessed formats and a documented feedback rubric.
source_evidence: Multiple modes of representation, engagement and demonstration are designed into learning activities.
corrected_action: Pilot with a diverse learner group; check functionality, outcomes and any required accommodations.
critical_error: No decisive defect within the supplied scenario.
